title: Why Cruise Ship Outbreaks Keep Climbing
hook: One stomach virus keeps finding its way onto ships packed with thousands of people.
closing: Crowded cruises give contagious illness thousands of chances to spread.
question: Would outbreaks change your cruise pick?

segments.say: Reported cruise outbreaks hit 20 last year, continuing a three-year climb.
Norovirus alone caused 15 of those outbreaks, making one bug the main repeat offender.
Some cruise ships carry 7,600 guests at once, giving norovirus a huge crowd of close contacts to spread through.
